tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything: the lightest (light) or deepest (dark) cool neutral.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Recessed canvas: panel wells, and the label colour of the primary button (`canvas` on `ink`). `ink` reads on it at 14:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers and inputs: the white (light) or raised grey (dark) plane every primitive sits on.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside a card: neutral chips, secondary-button hover, table sub-rows.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row and quiet-button hover wash.

tokens.name: hover-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hover, and the resting fill of the ghost button.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `page`, `canvas`, `surface` and `inset` (14:1+ in both themes). Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, descriptions, meta. 5.2:1+ on `surface` and `canvas` in both themes. Secondary gets colour, not weight.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, captions, timestamps, disabled glyphs. The source value misses 4.5:1 (2.7:1 on `surface` in light, 3.1:1 in dark), so keep it to non-essential text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default hairline border and dividers; the ring inside `shadow-card` and `shadow-hairline`. Solid, never alpha.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: button rings (`shadow-btn`), control borders, ghost-button hover.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Faintest divider: rows inside dense lists and tables.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input and text-field fill.

tokens.name: stripe
tokens.usage: The diagonal hatch line of the gallery backdrop (translucent ink).

tokens.name: stripe-bg
tokens.usage: Ground under the diagonal hatch backdrop of the gallery site.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one blue accent: focus ring (2px, 2px offset), active states, the accent button, selected dots. 3.6:1 on `surface` in light, so use it for rings, icons and fills, not small text.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and links on `surface` (4.8:1 light, 8.0:1 dark) and on `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Accent wash: text selection, accent chips and pills, selected rows.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success and completed: status dots, pill text, the success button. Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind `green` status pills.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Warning and needs-review. In light, `orange` on `orange-tint` is 2.7:1 in the source, so always pair it with a word.

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind `orange` status pills.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Error, failed and destructive. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind `red` status pills.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Chart tooltip ground, dark in both themes.

tokens.name: tooltip-fg
tokens.usage: Chart tooltip text on `tooltip-bg` (14:1+).

tokens.name: tooltip-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary tooltip text (series labels) on `tooltip-bg` (6.3:1+).

tokens.name: tooltip-border
tokens.usage: Tooltip hairline edge.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section and hero headings (`text-2xl font-semibold tracking-[-0.02em]`).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy, set on `body` with the `cv11` and `ss01` features.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Values in text rows and emphasised body; use `tabular-nums` for figures.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The workhorse UI size: menu items, card titles (at 600), secondary text in `ink-2`.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.usage: Dense rows, chip labels, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and footnotes, usually in `ink-3`; the `xs` button.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Counters, badges, pill labels and keyboard hints.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: Code listings and diffs in `CodeBlock` and `ToolChips`.

spacing.note: A 4px grid (Tailwind --spacing: 0.25rem) plus the shared primitive offsets from globals.css.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding (`primitive-card-pad`) and the sides of card bars and table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters and gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: card-bar-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of card header bars (`primitive-card-bar`, 10px 12px), footers (`primitive-card-footer`, 10px) and table cells (`primitive-table-cell`, 10px 12px).

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Square size of icon buttons (`primitive-icon-button`), with `radius-control`.

radius.note: Tight radii: chip 6, control 8, card 10, window 14, pill.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, small badges (`rounded-chip`, `rounded-md`).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, menu items, icon buttons, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Windows, large composers, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons (pill by default), status pills, switches.

shadow.note: A solid hairline ring plus smooth, layered single-digit-opacity stacks (shadow-plugin). In dark the ring becomes a faint white edge.

tokens.name: shadow-hairline
tokens.usage: A 1px `line` ring with no blur: flat tiles, swatches, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-btn
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons: a `line-strong` ring plus a whisper of lift.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels, the default elevation: ring plus a smooth layered shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating cards: the composer, hovered or dragged cards.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs: the highest elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-field
tokens.usage: Pressed-in fields and wells.
